Unplanned post-launch support is the silent killer of agency profit margins.

When you spend 15 hours a week answering questions already explained in handover videos, you are working for free.

Automate client answers instead of jumping on calls.

#SaaS #webdev #vibecoding

Most AI tools are completely blind to what is actually happening on your screen.

They rely entirely on microphone audio transcripts. If you didn't say it out loud while recording, the AI cannot find it. || This is a massive bottleneck for engineering teams and client handovers.

When a client asks 'Where is the billing button?', audio-only search fails if you never spoke those exact words on camera. || Demoly solves this by capturing the browser DOM tree instead of raw pixel video.

Every click, input field, layout state, and route change is indexed with precise timestamps. || When an AI agent or client queries your recording, it inspects the actual UI elements rendered on screen.

No voiceover required. The DOM structure tells the exact story. || How does your team currently handle searching through technical walkthroughs and bug recordings?

#ai #programming #automation
